mission.quote: Most of the world’s 7,000 languages have little or no digital presence. We think every speaker deserves technology that understands them.
mission.lede: We bring linguists, computer scientists and language communities together to build data, tools and models for languages that today’s technology leaves behind.

pillars.title: Interdisciplinary
pillars.description: Linguistics, machine learning, speech science and social science, working on the same problems.

pillars.title: Community-led
pillars.description: Speakers shape the questions we ask and own the data they help create.

pillars.title: Open by default
pillars.description: We release datasets, models and code openly wherever communities agree.

themes.title: Low-resource language modelling
themes.description: Training and adapting language models when only a few thousand sentences exist, through transfer, data augmentation and careful evaluation.

themes.title: Speech and oral traditions
themes.description: Many languages are spoken far more than they are written. We build speech recognition and synthesis for oral-first languages and archives.

themes.title: Documentation and corpus building
themes.description: Methods and tools for collecting, annotating and preserving language data together with speaker communities.

themes.title: Multilingual and code-mixed language
themes.description: Studying how people mix languages and scripts in everyday speech and text, and building systems that handle it naturally.
